cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Co-Sign This
cards.instruction: Get someone to help by making them an official participant who shares responsibility for the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've named you co-organizer of Saturday's school trip. Approve the route; you no longer need me to check every road on your map.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only offered to drive. Your route misses the museum.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good catch. All those checks I made you do paid off. Correct it and initial beside my name; we'll both stand behind this route.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll fix it, but you explain any delays to the parents.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stand beside you. You're our transport lead now; use the calm explanation we practised when you took your first trip. We'll answer their questions together.
